title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Goodwill Ledger Rule: Amount of the Alignment Comeback Credit
content:
The comeback credit is the order's alignment correction charge times a window share of 0.20 and a repair-class weight of 0.60, never more than the tier's goodwill credit authority less the goodwill already written off on the order, and never more than the correction charge, rounded to the cent, half up. The comeback window is measured in calendar days from the claim repair's delivery date to the date of the order's latest out-of-spec alignment check.

This governs the comeback credit on an ADAS Sensor Calibrations customer-pay order whose vehicle came from a network insurance claim repair.

## Quantities, defined

- **Correction charge:** the alignment correction charge in the order's calibration money history.
- **Comeback window:** calendar days from the delivered date of the vehicle's network insurance claim repair to the date of the order's latest out-of-spec alignment check, counted from the earlier date to the later date, the earlier date not counted.
- **When a credit is owed:** a credit is owed where the claim repair was delivered no more than 180 days before the end of the comeback window. Where the window is more than 180 days, the comeback credit is 0.00.
- **Goodwill already written off:** the total of the goodwill write-offs already booked on the order.
- **Figure:** the correction charge multiplied by the window share of 0.20 and by the repair-class weight of 0.60, each acting on the correction charge. The comeback credit is the lowest of three figures — that product; the tier's goodwill credit authority less the goodwill already written off (never below zero); and the correction charge — and only that lowest figure is rounded to the cent, half up (a figure short of the half cent by no more than 0.0001 of a cent is treated as reaching it).

## Worked cases (hypothetical: correction charge 129.95 USD, tier goodwill credit authority 45.00 USD)

| Comeback window (days) | Goodwill already written off | Product of charge, 0.20 and 0.60 | Authority less goodwill already | Comeback credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 60 | 0.00 | 15.594 | 45.00 | 15.59 |
| 60 | 40.00 | 15.594 | 5.00 | 5.00 |
| 60 | 50.00 | 15.594 | 0.00 (never below zero) | 0.00 |
| 180 | 0.00 | 15.594 | 45.00 | 15.59 |
| 181 | 0.00 | — | — | 0.00 |

Worked through for the first row: 129.95 multiplied by 0.20 is 25.99, and multiplied by 0.60 that is 15.594; the lowest of 15.594, 45.00 and 129.95 is 15.594, which rounds to 15.59 USD.
